items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Hamp persuaded me to give that up and come with him... Hamp talked to me about come and join him. Everybody that Hamp brought to New York with him.

ctx.x: When did you take your own band into the Club Congo?
This is what I'm coming to right now. I went into the Club Congo. It was a good band, too. But I came through there, and Hamp changed my mind about the whole situation.
